blocks.text: Perhaps the most famous natural wonder of Korea is an island called Jeju.
Jeju island is a favorite place amongst Korean newlyweds to go on their honeymoons.
There are so many fun things to do on Jeju Island and many beautiful spots to visit.
Mt. Halla is the most visible attraction on Jeju Island.
It is located in the center of Jeju Island and is the highest mountain in South Korea; it’s almost 2,000 meters high (about 6500 feet).
